reviews.name: Liyema
reviews.text: Great environment! Was there for work but couldn’t wait to come back “home”, yes! It is homey, peaceful, private and in a safe environment!

reviews.name: Nwabisa
reviews.text: Hosts are so kind very proactive, smooth communication. Place is lovely, very neat, in a good location with lots to do. Thank you Clifford!!

reviews.name: Letta
reviews.text: Happy to be hosted by you in your place.

reviews.name: Annalize
reviews.text: I had a lovely stay at Clifford’s Place. The accommodation was clean, comfortable, and welcoming, and I felt at ease throughout my stay.

reviews.name: Theriza
reviews.text: Lovely stay at a lovely place. Thank you.

reviews.name: Matt
reviews.text: Amazing as always, second time I’ve been and very happy.

reviews.name: Leila
reviews.text: Cliffords place was a joy for the kids. Its spacious. Great braai area place. Quite and private. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Sylvester
reviews.text: The place was amazing, the bed was very comfortable, such a private space that offered me quality time to simple relax and reflect.

reviews.name: Gert
reviews.text: I would recommend this stay anytime!

reviews.name: Sinoyolo
reviews.text: Had such a great stay , the house is very spacious in a quiet and safe area and definitely worth its value . Host communication was top tier !

reviews.name: Sibu
reviews.text: I am definitely considering them for my next trip. Everything was just perfect.

reviews.name: Matt
reviews.text: A great cozy stay, super close to everything and accessible. Would highly recommend staying here on visits to the area.

reviews.name: Shoneel
reviews.text: Had an amazing stay.... Will definitely recommend

reviews.name: Ramis
reviews.text: Everything is perfect

reviews.name: Hassan
reviews.text: Clifford was such a great host, responsive and helpful. Would highly recommend the property. Experience was 10/10.

reviews.name: Yonela
reviews.text: It was perfect and the hostess is amazing

reviews.name: Viani
reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay with Clifford and Bonnita! The accommodation was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described.

reviews.name: Yanga
reviews.text: Pleasant and friends hosts, the place is beautiful and cosy.

reviews.name: Nazia
reviews.text: Really enjoyed staying here. The place was lovely, clean, and comfortable. The hosts were so friendly and sweet, and they made us feel right at home.

reviews.name: Azza
reviews.text: I booked this place last minute, and Clifford was very helpful and accommodating.

reviews.name: Puneet
reviews.text: I made this reservation at the very last minute, and it turned out to be one of the best stays of my trip.

reviews.name: Xolani
reviews.text: Lovely cosy place value for money with a fantastic host🤗thank you!

reviews.name: Zimone
reviews.text: Thanks Clifford and Bonnita we enjoyed our stay!

reviews.name: Catherine
reviews.text: We were only there for one night, but it was comfortable, clean, quiet and everything that we needed.

reviews.name: Jared
reviews.text: It was a Safe,Cozy,peace and quiet place to getaway. Ideal for a quick getaway or a place to work. Hosts are very friendly, kind and helpful.

reviews.name: John
reviews.text: This is the perfect place for couples or singles. Great value for money, great host, and quiet neighborhood. I'll definitely stay again.

reviews.name: Chadd
reviews.text: Our stay was absolutely amazing, peaceful and quiet,the place was nice and neat.

units.name: Noor 1 · 1 Bedroom
units.description: A furnished 1-bedroom apartment at Noor 1 by Deyaar in Midtown, Dubai Production City, with a private balcony and tall windows. The community has a landscaped courtyard and a swimming pool.

units.name: Noor 1 · Unit 802
units.description: A 1-bedroom apartment at Noor 1 by Deyaar in Midtown, Dubai Production City, with a private balcony and tall windows. The community has a landscaped courtyard and a swimming pool.

units.name: Sunrise Bay
units.description: Furnished 1-bedroom homes at Sunrise Bay, Emaar Beachfront, with private balconies looking over the marina, the beach and the skyline. The community has a private beach and an infinity pool.

units.name: Liva
units.description: A furnished 1-bedroom apartment at Liva in Town Square, with a living room that opens onto a private balcony. The building has a podium pool and a staffed reception.
amenities: Private balcony with table and chairs

units.name: The Square Tower
units.description: A furnished open-plan studio at The Square Tower in JVC, with the bed, a sitting area and the kitchen in one bright space.

units.name: The Lofts West
units.description: A furnished 2-bedroom apartment at The Lofts West in Downtown Dubai, with 2.5 bathrooms and a private balcony with a glimpse of the Burj Khalifa. It sleeps four and has a fully equipped kitchen. The building has a podium pool.

photos.alt: Burj Khalifa view from the balcony

units.name: Sea View 1BR, Sunrise Bay
units.description: A furnished 1-bedroom apartment at Sunrise Bay, Emaar Beachfront, with a private balcony and sea views. It has a double bed and a sofa bed and sleeps up to four, with private beach access, an infinity pool and free parking.

units.name: Serenity by the Sea, Sunrise Bay
units.description: A furnished 1-bedroom apartment at Sunrise Bay, Emaar Beachfront, with a private balcony looking over the sea, the marina and Atlantis. It has a queen bed and a sofa bed and sleeps up to four. Guests have the private beach, the infinity pool and the gym.

units.name: Sunrise Bay 1906
units.description: A furnished 1-bedroom apartment, the same layout and style as Serenity by the Sea, at Sunrise Bay, Emaar Beachfront, with a private balcony looking over the sea, the marina and Atlantis. It has a queen bed and a sofa bed and sleeps up to four. Guests have the private beach, the infinity pool and the gym.

units.name: 2 Bedroom Penthouse, Plaza Residences
units.description: A furnished 2-bedroom penthouse at Plaza Residences in JVC, with 2.5 bathrooms and a huge private terrace for sitting and dining outdoors. It sleeps four and has a fully equipped kitchen.

units.name: Modern JVT Villa
units.description: A renovated 5-bedroom villa in Jumeirah Village Triangle, with a private garden, an above-ground pool, an outdoor gym and a BBQ. It sleeps eight, with 3.5 bathrooms, free parking and an 85-inch cinema TV. The ground-floor fifth bedroom has an ensuite wet room and is easy to access.

units.name: Luxe Studio, The Wings
units.description: A furnished studio at The Wings in Arjan, near Miracle Garden, with a double bed, a seating area, a private balcony and a full kitchen. The building has a swimming pool and a gym.

units.name: Downtown Luxe Retreat
units.description: A furnished 2-bedroom apartment at Boulevard Central in Downtown Dubai, opposite Dubai Mall.

units.name: Lakeside 3BR
units.description: A 3-bedroom lakeside home in Cape Town with mountain views and a patio BBQ area.

units.name: The Green Lawn House
units.description: A home in Gqeberha (Port Elizabeth) with a green lawn and garden.

units.name: The Grey House
units.description: A 2-bedroom home in Mount Pleasant, Gqeberha, with a bar and an open kitchen.

units.name: Garden Retreat
units.description: A cosy suite in Gqeberha with a private patio and a fire pit.
